question:
How many red cars are there?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ed6ab4900f06339ca831b1d1cb6ab16513f217e4a810e1d139b00214a770f9f2.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a50faa315b48435cb98d4fe168582116e378e91db1842eb5b884f2ab6aba584.png] 

The shaded area shows the "Red Cars".

So, there are: 14 + 5 + 6 + 8 = 33 red cars are there in the given figure.

Hence, the correct answer is "33".
